name: CyberAlchemy Language Project
purpose: Develop a coherent, context-aware language system so business speech, CyberAlchemy definitions, DomainSpec models, formal claims, implementation, and evidence can refer to the same meanings without silently collapsing their different representations.
scope: recurring disciplines for discovering, using, checking, and evolving shared language
typed mappings between business expressions, DomainSpec concepts, formal claims, implementation terms, and evidence
explicit bindings from bounded-context language to the CyberAlchemy authority model without transferring authority
language drift, ambiguity, conflict, translation, and residue
exclusions: one universal vocabulary for every bounded context
automatic promotion of frequently used words
replacement of the canonical CyberAlchemy definition store
automatic equivalence between business, mathematical, and implementation expressions
proof that a shared term is understood merely because it appears consistently
implementation, publication, deployment, or external effects
owner_routes: the named owner of each bounded-context language

evidence_index.supports: The package contains separate candidate Language and Ubiquitous Language meanings with explicit boundaries.
evidence_index.claim_limit: Does not establish canonical meaning, discipline admission, shared understanding, or successful downstream use.

challenge_route: Challenge Project scope or thesis fit through the CyberAlchemy v2 product owner; challenge term meaning or promotion through definitions-governance; challenge a bounded-context language through its named language owner.
